I answered Tobias in his thread in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was **Southgate**.

- **Where it comes from:** On 3 Sep 2025, Pree posted in that channel that label printing had stalled and Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. When she closed the incident at 18:43, she said Southgate had cleared the backlog. Tobias is a member of that channel, so he can see those messages himself.
- **What I couldn't confirm:** The channel never says which city Southgate is in, so I suggested he ask Pree if he needs the exact location for the call.
- **What I left out:** An outage write-up Pree emailed to the customer names a Tulsa yard instead. Tobias can't see that email, so I didn't use or mention it. That email and the brain results also included pricing and contract figures, which I left out as well.
